mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO PERF_TARGET_VALUE (id, plan_id, subject_type, subject_id, cycle_key, metric_code, target_value, base_value, stage_name, start_date, end_date, owner_emp_id, owner_org_code, created_by, created_time) VALUES
(#{v.id}, #{v.planId}, #{v.subjectType}, #{v.subjectId}, #{v.cycleKey}, #{v.metricCode}, #{v.targetValue}, #{v.baseValue}, #{v.stageName}, #{v.startDate}, #{v.endDate}, #{v.ownerEmpId}, #{v.ownerOrgCode}, #{v.createdBy}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_value = VALUES(target_value), base_value = VALUES(base_value), stage_name = VALUES(stage_name), start_date = VALUES(start_date), end_date = VALUES(end_date), owner_emp_id = VALUES(owner_emp_id), owner_org_code = VALUES(owner_org_code), updated_time = NOW(), updated_by = VALUES(created_by)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId FROM PERF_TARGET_VALUE WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY subject_type, subject_id
SELECT DISTINCT stage_name FROM PERF_TARGET_VALUE WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND stage_name IS NOT NULL AND stage_name <> '' ORDER BY stage_name
